Drone Explodes Near Bulgarian Gas Pipeline Close to Romanian Border

An unidentified drone carrying a significant amount of explosives exploded near a gas pipeline close to Bulgaria's border with Romania. Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev stated that neither Bulgarian nor Romanian authorities detected the drone in their airspace. No casualties were reported as a result of the explosion.
